name: Granby Ranch
description: As one of the last independent ski resorts in the state, find the perfect place to learn to ski at Granby Ranch. With 1,000 vertical ft on over 400 acres of skiable terrain funneling from 2 peaks to a common base, you'll enjoy a welcoming, stress-free atmosphere where adventure meets convenience. Just 90 miles from Denver, experience our family-owned, family-friendly resort every step of the way. Skip the lines, avoid the crowds, park for free, and make time for moments that matter.
